said.q: Intense depiction If there is one painting that gives an intense depiction of the sweltering heat, the arid land, the crooked, twisting trunks and branches and the atmosphere of an olive grove in Provence, it is this work by Vincent van Gogh. Beautiful fields From May 1889 Van Gogh stays in the asylum at Saint-Rémy.

events.n: painted in the olive groves near the asylum, where he stayed from May 1889
events.q: From May 1889 Van Gogh stays in the asylum at Saint-Rémy. When he feels well enough and has permission to paint outside the grounds, he often visits the olive groves in the area.
